description: Kernel-mystery probe: Excel's small-x erf on runs of 128 consecutive mantissas at x = 0.1478 to 0.1490 in steps of 5E-5. They locate where the small-x model stops fitting, so it can be compared with the computed zero of the fine factor (x near 0.14838). Runs: x0=0.14780 row=1; x0=0.14785 row=129; x0=0.14790 row=257; x0=0.14795 row=385; x0=0.14800 row=513; x0=0.14805 row=641; x0=0.14810 row=769; x0=0.14815 row=897; x0=0.14820 row=1025; x0=0.14825 row=1153; x0=0.14830 row=1281; x0=0.14835 row=1409; x0=0.14840 row=1537; x0=0.14845 row=1665; x0=0.14850 row=1793; x0=0.14855 row=1921; x0=0.14860 row=2049; x0=0.14865 row=2177; x0=0.14870 row=2305; x0=0.14875 row=2433; x0=0.14880 row=2561; x0=0.14885 row=2689; x0=0.14890 row=2817; x0=0.14895 row=2945; x0=0.14900 row=3073. B = ERF.PRECISE(x).
